name: Pulse Music v4.2.4 - Butter-Smooth 120Hz Normal Mode & Full Spotify Login Playlists
body:
# Pulse Music v4.2.4 - Butter-Smooth 120Hz Normal Mode & Full Spotify Login Playlists

Official multi-platform release and global OTA update for **Android**, **Windows**, **Orion Store**, **F-Droid**, **Obtainium**, and **Web**.

---

### ⚡ Butter-Smooth Scrolling & Selection in Normal Mode
- **120Hz Native Display Unlock**: Automatically enables your display's highest native refresh rate (90Hz / 120Hz / 144Hz) on Android so normal mode scrolls smoothly right out of the box.
- **Zero-Lag Scrolling & Selection**: Eliminated unused root offscreen compositing layers, multi-card carousel offscreen fade allocations, duplicate row modifiers, per-row `animateContentSize` overhead, scroll-direction layout bounce, and list thumbnail crossfade stalls.
- **Balanced GPU Shaders**: Refined blur radii and glass dispersion overhead so translucent surfaces stay visually crisp without frame drops.

- **Minimal Greeting Header**: Removed the "Pulse Music" app name text from the Home top bar for a cleaner greeting-first layout.

### 🎧 Full Spotify Login Playlists, Trending & Liked Songs
- **Native Playlist & Liked Songs Parity**: Browse and open Spotify playlists, **Spotify Liked Songs**, **Trending Songs**, **Trending Playlists**, and **Listening History** directly in Home and Library — with instant track loading, Play All, Shuffle, Start Radio, Queue, and Offline Downloads just like YouTube Music login playlists.
- **Hardened Credential Protection**: Upgraded the internal Spotify web-player engine with obfuscated credential storage and stripped debug/header logging across requests.
changelog: Normal Mode Smoothness: Enabled native high-refresh-rate display mode (90Hz/120Hz/144Hz), removed heavy offscreen scroll layers, eliminated selection/scroll row jank, and tuned GPU blur shaders
Clean Home Header: Removed 'Pulse Music' app title text from the Home top bar
Spotify Login Playlists & Trending: Full playlist browsing, Spotify Liked Songs, Trending Songs & Playlists, Shuffle, Radio, and instant stream resolution matching YouTube Music playlists
Security Hardening: Obfuscated internal web-player configuration and disabled secret/header logging
